scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: Solar flares release high-energy charged particles that can penetrate unprotected spacecraft walls.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: NASA's RadLab research confirms that hydrogen-rich water-filled walls absorb space radiation more efficiently than traditional metals.
